title: Danette
summary: A series of short-form AI-generated advertisements created for Danette, focused on presenting its dessert and dairy products through cinematic, product-driven visuals.
description:
A series of short-form AI-generated advertisements created for Danette, focused on presenting its dessert and dairy products through cinematic, product-driven visuals.

I developed the project end-to-end, including concept development, creative direction, visual development, AI production, editing, post-production, and final delivery.

The campaign was produced through a fully AI-driven workflow, with each video designed as a concise digital advertisement built around strong product presentation and visual storytelling.
